headline: Cadence internship posting proposes evaluating generative AI for real-number-model creation
fact: Cadence posted a Milan internship role that proposes investigating generative AI on industry cases, validating AI flows, and using Model in Minutes in the Virtuoso environment to build real-number models. This is an exploratory internship mandate and product-evaluation signal, not proof of a deployed customer methodology or validated productivity result.

sources.title: Cadence University Careers: Intern on AMS Tool in Milan
sources.summary: Official Cadence requisition R55238-2, posted August 24, 2026, describes the exploratory generative-AI evaluation and Model in Minutes real-number-model work.
